_what: The places besides its own a screen can be opened, offered wherever a screen is (a sidebar row's menu and hover card, a Find anything result): each `request` is laid over the open request (parts/ui/show/placeable-surface-intent), as a pane beside the one in use (`placement`) or a new floating window (`open_placement`: its layer, its size, and `anchor`, where its centre sits as fractions of the screen). Clicking opens a screen in its own place; these are the others. A new place is one row.
